adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, when a topic_id exists it directly instantiates `TopicView.new(topic_id, current_user, {best: 5})` with no error handling. If `TopicView` raises (e.g., for deleted/private/restricted topics), the exception will bubble up and the iframe will receive whatever the global exception handler renders rather than a controlled embed-specific response. The diff does not show the exception pages/layout behavior, so the “full site error page” part isn’t strictly verifiable, but the lack of graceful handling for inaccessible topics is diff-grounded.
